rows.text: Adeline does not need to attack. Her trigger is "whenever you attack" — send any one creature and she makes a 1/1 Human attacking EACH opponent, three tokens a turn at a four-player table. Her power equals your creature count and she has vigilance, so she can swing and still stand guard. Everything else here either makes that trigger bigger, pumps the tokens, or turns them into cards.
There's also a two-card kill: Heliod and Walking Ballista — see the combo.
Her tokens are Humans. That is what the Human cards here are for — Greymond, Thalia's Lieutenant, Coppercoat Vanguard and Beregond all count them.

rows.name: Adeline, Resplendent Cathar
rows.text: three mana, vigilance, power equal to your creature count, and three attacking tokens every time you attack. Attack every turn, even with one token, to keep the tokens coming.

rows.name: Lightning Greaves
rows.text: shroud the turn Adeline lands, and haste so she attacks straight away. Never equip it to Walking Ballista — shroud stops Heliod giving it lifelink or counters.

rows.name: Mother of Runes
rows.text: taps to give Adeline protection from a colour — the colour of the removal pointed at her.

rows.name: Giver of Runes
rows.text: the same, and it can also give protection from colourless.

rows.name: Heliod, Sun-Crowned
rows.text: whenever you gain life, a +1/+1 counter on a creature or enchantment you control; {1}{W} gives another creature lifelink. It also puts a counter on a token every time Ocelot Pride or Belladonna Took gains you life.

rows.name: Walking Ballista
rows.text: give it lifelink with Heliod, then remove a counter: 1 damage, 1 life, and Heliod puts the counter straight back. Unlimited damage — the whole table dies. Cast it for X of 2 or more: with only one counter it dies the moment you remove it, before Heliod puts one back — unless Flowering of the White Tree or Wedding Festivity is giving it +1/+1.

rows.name: Idyllic Tutor
rows.text: finds Heliod, which is an enchantment.

rows.name: Recruiter of the Guard
rows.text: finds any creature with toughness 2 or less — Walking Ballista has 0, so it's the second way to find the combo, along with Mother of Runes and Giver of Runes.

rows.name: Search for Glory
rows.text: finds any legendary card — Heliod.

rows.name: Ranger of Eos
rows.text: finds two creatures with mana value 1 or less — Walking Ballista and Mother of Runes to protect the combo.

rows.name: Roaming Throne
rows.text: name Human. Adeline is a Human, so her trigger happens twice: six tokens every attack. It doubles Hero of Bladehold, Myrel, Thalia's Lieutenant, Beregond, Goldnight Commander and Mentor of the Meek the same way.

rows.name: Anointed Procession
rows.text: every token effect makes twice as many.

rows.name: Mondrak, Glory Dominus
rows.text: the same, on a 4/4.

rows.name: Elspeth, Storm Slayer
rows.text: the same again, plus two Soldiers every turn (she doubles her own) or a +1/+1 counter and flying for your whole team. Adeline with Roaming Throne and one doubler is twelve tokens an attack.

rows.name: Hero of Bladehold
rows.text: two more attacking Soldiers, and +1/+0 to every other attacker.

rows.name: Myrel, Shield of Argive
rows.text: when it attacks, a 1/1 Soldier for every Soldier you control — Hero's tokens count. Your opponents can't cast spells or use artifact, creature or enchantment abilities during your turn.

rows.name: Voice of Victory
rows.text: two attacking Warriors each time it attacks (sacrificed at the next end step), and your opponents can't cast spells during your turn.

rows.name: Castle Ardenvale
rows.text: spare mana into another Human every turn.

rows.name: Ocelot Pride
rows.text: a Cat at your end step if you gained life. Once you control ten permanents, it copies every token that entered this turn and is still yours.

rows.name: Elspeth, Sun's Champion
rows.text: three Soldiers a turn. Careful with −3: it destroys every creature with power 4 or more, which includes Adeline and your own pumped tokens.

rows.name: Cathars' Crusade
rows.text: every creature that enters puts a +1/+1 counter on EACH creature you control. Six tokens entering is +6/+6 on everything, before combat damage.

rows.name: Intangible Virtue
rows.text: tokens get +1/+1 and vigilance.

rows.name: Flowering of the White Tree
rows.text: nonlegendary creatures +1/+1; legendary ones +2/+1 and ward {1}.

rows.name: Greymond, Avacyn's Stalwart
rows.text: pick two of first strike, vigilance and lifelink for every Human; with four Humans out, Humans also get +2/+2.

rows.name: Coppercoat Vanguard
rows.text: other Humans +1/+0 and ward {1}.

rows.name: Thalia's Lieutenant
rows.text: a +1/+1 counter on every other Human when it enters, and it grows with every Human after.

rows.name: Beregond of the Guard
rows.text: whenever a Human enters, your creatures get +1/+1 and vigilance until end of turn — and Adeline's tokens are Humans entering mid-combat.

rows.name: Goldnight Commander
rows.text: whenever a creature enters, your creatures get +1/+1 until end of turn.

rows.name: Wedding Announcement
rows.text: a card or a Human each end step; after three turns it flips into +1/+1 for your team.

rows.name: Abandoned Air Temple
rows.text: {3}{W} and a tap: a +1/+1 counter on each creature.

rows.name: Mirror Entity
rows.text: {X}: your creatures become X/X. With a wide board, five mana makes every token a 5/5.

rows.name: Akroma's Will
rows.text: with Adeline out, both modes: flying, vigilance and double strike, plus lifelink, indestructible and protection from every colour. Protection from white also stops Heliod targeting your creatures, so finish the Ballista combo before casting it.

rows.name: Emeria's Call
rows.text: a land early; late, two 4/4 flying Angels and indestructibility for your non-Angel creatures until your next turn.

rows.name: Rogue's Passage
rows.text: {4}: Adeline can't be blocked.

rows.name: The One Ring
rows.text: cast it for protection from everything until your next turn, then draw more cards every turn.

rows.name: Caretaker's Talent
rows.text: a card the first time tokens enter each turn. Level 2 ({W}) copies a token once; level 3 ({3}{W}) gives all your creature tokens +2/+2.

rows.name: Enduring Innocence
rows.text: a card once a turn when small creatures enter. When it dies it comes back as an enchantment and keeps drawing.

rows.name: Tocasia's Welcome
rows.text: a card once a turn when a creature with mana value 3 or less enters — tokens count.

rows.name: Welcoming Vampire
rows.text: a card once a turn when small creatures enter.

rows.name: Mentor of the Meek
rows.text: pay {1} to draw for each small creature that enters, as many as you can pay for.

rows.name: Idol of Oblivion
rows.text: taps to draw on any turn you made a token.

rows.name: Minas Tirith
rows.text: {1}{W}: a card on any turn you declared two or more attackers.

rows.name: Belladonna Took
rows.text: each turn, the first token gains you a life, the second draws a card, the third puts a +1/+1 counter on every creature you control.

rows.name: Trouble in Pairs
rows.text: draws when an opponent attacks you with two or more creatures, draws their second card, or casts their second spell in a turn.

rows.name: Esper Sentinel
rows.text: taxes each opponent's first noncreature spell each turn or draws you a card.

rows.name: Skullclamp
rows.text: equip a 1/1 token and it dies: two cards for one mana.

rows.name: War Room
rows.text: a card for one life and three mana.

rows.name: Land Tax
rows.text: three basic lands to hand each of your upkeeps an opponent has more lands than you — thinning the deck and feeding the draws.

rows.name: Sol Ring
rows.text: the fastest start.

rows.name: Arcane Signet
rows.text: a second mana rock.

rows.name: Mind Stone
rows.text: ramp early, a card later.

rows.name: Pearl Medallion
rows.text: every white spell costs one less, nearly the whole deck — not Walking Ballista or activated abilities.

rows.name: Knight of the White Orchid
rows.text: a first-striker that fetches a Plains when you're behind on lands.

rows.name: Smothering Tithe
rows.text: every card an opponent draws is two mana from them or a Treasure for you.

rows.name: Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx
rows.text: mono-white devotion adds up fast.

rows.name: Three Tree City
rows.text: name Human: {2} and a tap makes a white mana for every Human you control.

rows.name: Springleaf Drum
rows.text: tap it and an untapped creature — a token made this turn works — for one mana of any colour.

rows.name: Teferi's Protection
rows.text: the whole board phases out until your next turn.

rows.name: Flawless Maneuver
rows.text: free with Adeline out; your creatures become indestructible.

rows.name: Clever Concealment
rows.text: phases out any of your nonland permanents; convoke means your tokens pay for it.

rows.name: Galadriel's Dismissal
rows.text: phase out one creature for {W} — or kicked, every creature one player controls. Point it at yourself to dodge a sweeper, or at an opponent to remove their blockers for a turn.

rows.name: Flare of Fortitude
rows.text: free by sacrificing a nontoken white creature: your life total can't change and your permanents gain hexproof and indestructible. Your life can't change that turn, which also switches off the Heliod combo — don't use it on the turn you go off.

rows.name: Boromir, Warden of the Tower
rows.text: counters every spell an opponent casts without paying mana, and sacrifices itself to make your creatures indestructible.

rows.name: Grand Abolisher
rows.text: during your turn, opponents can't cast spells or use artifact, creature or enchantment abilities.

rows.name: Ranger-Captain of Eos
rows.text: finds a creature with mana value 1 or less — Walking Ballista counts, at 0 — and sacrificing it means opponents can't cast noncreature spells this turn, which protects the combo.

rows.name: Silence
rows.text: one mana and nobody else casts spells this turn. Cast it before you start the combo.

rows.name: Aven Interrupter
rows.text: flash: exile the spell aimed at your combo — even one that can't be countered. Its owner can recast it later, by which point the game is over.

rows.name: Swords to Plowshares
rows.text: one mana, any creature.

rows.name: Path to Exile
rows.text: the second one.

rows.name: Winds of Abandon
rows.text: one creature for two mana, or overloaded for six: every creature your opponents control is exiled.

rows.name: Council's Judgment
rows.text: every player votes, and the most-voted nonland permanents are exiled — it doesn't target, so hexproof doesn't help them.

rows.name: Generous Gift
rows.text: any permanent; they get a 3/3.

rows.name: Loran of the Third Path
rows.text: destroys an artifact or enchantment, then trades cards with an opponent.

rows.name: Witch Enchanter
rows.text: destroys an artifact or enchantment, or plays as a land.

rows.name: Eiganjo, Seat of the Empire
rows.text: a land that deals 4 to an attacking or blocking creature.

rows.name: Charismatic Conqueror
rows.text: whenever an opponent's creature or artifact enters untapped, they tap it or you get a lifelink Vampire.

guide.title: What to keep in an opening hand

rows.text: Keep three lands and something to cast on turn two. Adeline comes down on turn three and attacks from turn four.
Attack every turn, even with a single token — the trigger is what matters, not the damage.
The deck's enemy is a board wipe. Past eight or so creatures, keep Teferi's Protection, Flawless Maneuver, Clever Concealment or Flare of Fortitude ready before adding more.
Draw is where mono-white usually falls behind. Get one of Caretaker's Talent, Enduring Innocence, Tocasia's Welcome or The One Ring out early and you won't.
